s1.syndrome_frame: excessive sweating of the buttocks and sacrum with significant impact on daily life
salient_findings: excessive sweating of the buttocks, most severe at the intergluteal cleft and sacrum
previous successful treatment of axillary hyperhidrosis with 20% aluminum chloride
unsuccessful treatment of intergluteal cleft and sacrum with aluminum chloride
key_facts: 31-year-old male nursing student
history of axillary hyperhidrosis
excessive sweating of the buttocks
most severe sweating at the intergluteal cleft and sacrum
previous treatment with 20% aluminum chloride for axillary hyperhidrosis
unsuccessful treatment with aluminum chloride for intergluteal cleft and sacrum
uses absorbent pads due to severity of condition
unable to attend work due to condition
Minor starch-iodine test performed to localize areas of overactive sweating
significant sweating identified in sacral region (10 × 3-cm area) and intergluteal cleft (6 × 8-cm area)

shortlist.label: Localized Hyperhidrosis
shortlist.why_kept: excessive sweating localized to specific areas, such as the intergluteal cleft and sacrum

shortlist.label: Primary Hyperhidrosis
shortlist.why_kept: history of axillary hyperhidrosis and current symptoms of excessive sweating in the buttocks and sacrum

shortlist.label: Compensatory Hyperhidrosis
shortlist.why_kept: previous treatment with aluminum chloride for axillary hyperhidrosis, which may have led to compensatory sweating in other areas

shortlist.label: Hyperhidrosis
shortlist.why_kept: general diagnosis that encompasses various types of excessive sweating, including localized and primary hyperhidrosis

shortlist.label: Generalized Hyperhidrosis
shortlist.why_kept: although the sweating is currently localized, the possibility of progression to generalized hyperhidrosis cannot be ruled out

raw.rationale: Patient's symptoms are limited to specific areas (intergluteal cleft and sacrum), indicating a localized condition

rejected.label: Primary Hyperhidrosis
rejected.why: Primary hyperhidrosis typically involves multiple areas of the body, not just localized regions

rejected.label: Compensatory Hyperhidrosis
rejected.why: No indication of underlying condition causing compensatory sweating

rejected.label: Hyperhidrosis
rejected.why: Too broad, patient's condition is more specifically localized

rejected.label: Generalized Hyperhidrosis
rejected.why: Patient's symptoms are not widespread, but rather confined to specific areas
